== Ozma of Oz / A Record of Her Adventures with Dorothy Gale of Kansas, the Yellow Hen, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, the Cowardly Lion, and the Hungry Tiger; Besides Other Good People too Numerous to Mention Faithfully Recorded Herein ==

The Tiger is a striped, maneless companion who travels with Dorothy and the Cowardly Lion. He carries Dorothy on his back, who locks her arms around his striped neck for lack of a mane to cling to, and leaps clear between a giant iron guardian's legs to safety alongside the Lion and Ozma before its mallet strikes again. Addressed as "friend Tiger" by the Cowardly Lion, he agrees to face great danger with him to rescue a besieged army. Chronically hungry, he complains bitterly of being half-starved and begs to be allowed into the palace to become an ornament so he might no longer suffer the pangs of hunger. His appetite surfaces again when he eyes Billina greedily, remarking that her appearance "makes my mouth water," though he concedes it "wouldn't be right" to eat her. He also admits to being a little absent-minded at times.
</div>
